title: LawnMaster 48V MAX Brushless 16" 2-in-1 Dethatcher/Scarifier (CLGVB4816)

comparisons.notes: Exact title and model CLGVB4816, 48V/4Ah variant, new, sold and shipped by Skybest Appliance Center (Pro Seller)

writeup: LawnMaster's 48V MAX brushless 16-inch 2-in-1 dethatcher and scarifier (model CLGVB4816) is $129.99 new on Woot, versus $269.99 at Walmart. It has 14 depth settings and a 12-gallon collection bag, which makes it a handy fall tool for pulling thatch before overseeding. Woot limits it to 3 per customer and stock is very low.
